name: 95928 · Chico, CA
findings: ZIP 95928 (Chico) has 166 nonprofit organizations. 71 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 61 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (15% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 95928 (Chico) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 95928 (Chico) list civic or political action on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.8 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 6 organizations here; 31% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to take civic or political action so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
